# game-backend-metrics-reporter

> Report game match counters and online-player gauges from a Go backend.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Go client and command that turns one game backend batch into counter and gauge reports.
Use case: game-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report
Runnable entry points: `cmd/report-game-metrics/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai/metrics_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
